effect.shortEffect: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.
effect.full: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

french.sv: L’Attaque du Pokémon augmente si un vent arrière souffle\nou s’il est touché par une capacité faisant appel au vent.\nDans ce dernier cas, il ne subit aucun dégât.

english.sv: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

japanese.sv: おいかぜが　吹いたり　風技を　受けると ダメージを　受けずに 攻撃が　上がる。
